declarations.description:
A row of days to pick one from, like the day strips of booking, fitness and calendar apps (Airbnb, Strava, Google
Calendar on a phone): each day shows its weekday and number, the chosen one is filled, today is marked, and a dot
marks the days that have something on them. The buttons at the ends page through the days, a week at a time by
default (`days`), starting on the first day of the week in the page's language.

The value is a `YYYY-MM-DD` string in the local calendar, so it does not shift across time zones. `min` and `max`
disable the days outside them and stop the paging there. `markers` lists the days with a dot, each with an optional
label a screen reader hears with the day. `disabled-dates` turns off single days (fully booked, closed), which the arrow
keys step over.

The days are a list box with one tab stop: the arrow keys move by day and page on at the ends, Home and End go to
the first and last day shown, Page Up and Page Down page, and Enter or Space picks. It is a form control: under a
`name` the form receives the value, `required` asks for one, and it takes part in `c2-form-field`.

cssParts.description: The row with the month and the paging buttons.

members.name: value
members.description: The day picked, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

members.name: days
members.description: How many days show at once; the paging buttons move by as many. A week of 7 starts on the locale's first day of the week.

members.name: start
members.description: The first day shown, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to the start of the week (or page) holding the value, or today.

members.name: min
members.description: The earliest day that can be picked, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

members.name: max
members.description: The latest day that can be picked, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

members.name: disabledDates
members.description: Single days that cannot be picked, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. As an attribute, a `;`-separated list.

members.name: markers
members.description: The days with a dot. As an attribute, a JSON array of `"YYYY-MM-DD"` strings or `{ date, label }` objects.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the form receives the value under it.

members.name: required
members.description: Asks for a day before the form submits.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the strip off; the value is kept and, as for a disabled form control, not submitted.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the strip. Inside a `c2-form-field`, the field's label names it.

members.name: viewStart
members.description: The first day shown.

members.name: focusDay
members.description: The day holding the tab stop.

members.name: markerMap
members.description: The markers by day, rebuilt when `markers` changes.

members.name: rangeMoved
members.description: Set when a value from outside moved the days shown: `range-change` follows the render.

members.name: disabledSet
members.description: `disabledDates` as a set, rebuilt when it changes.

members.name: layoutLocale
members.description: The locale the page of days was laid out for: a week starts on its first day.

members.name: revealSelected
members.description: In a row too narrow for every day, scrolls the row (never the page) so the picked day is in sight.

members.name: pageStartFor
members.description: The first day of the page holding `day`: the week's first day for a page of 7, else `day` itself.

members.name: shown
members.description: The days shown, in order.

members.name: minDay
members.description: `min`, or nothing when it is not a `YYYY-MM-DD` day: a malformed bound must not disable whole months.

members.name: outOfRange
members.description: Outside `min`/`max`: no day further that way can be picked.

members.name: rangeTitle
members.description: The month (or two months) of the days shown, in the page's language.

events.name: range-change
events.description: Fired when other days come into view (paging, or a value that was not shown), with the first and last day now shown, so an app can load what is on them.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when the user picks a day, before `change`. Read `value`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the user picks a day. Not fired for programmatic changes.
